description: Read a portion of a Google Doc with pagination support. Use offset and limit to read large documents in chunks, avoiding output size limits.

account.description: Alias of the Google account to target. Optional — defaults to the session/global default account, or the sole authenticated account. Run manage_accounts list to see available aliases.

limit.description: Maximum characters to return per page (default: 50000, max: 80000; kept below the host's ~100K output cap to leave room for the JSON envelope and newline escaping)

offset.description: Character offset into the output text, not raw doc characters (with format=markdown the title prefix counts). 0-based, default: 0. Pass the previous response's nextOffset to get the following page.

tabId.description: Read a specific tab by ID (from listDocumentTabs). If omitted, all tabs are returned.

name: readGoogleDocPaginated
